find_files.description: Find visible files below required repository-relative directory path (empty string for root). pattern is relative to path; * matches one segment and ** any depth. Results are bounded and unpaged; when truncated, narrow path or pattern.

grep.description: Search visible UTF-8 text using required Python regex pattern, repository-relative path (empty for root), and relative glob file_pattern. Results and scanned bytes are bounded; when truncated, narrow pattern, path, or file_pattern.

read_file.description: Read a visible file using required path and version current|base|head. Inclusive one-based start_line and end_line may both be omitted for a bounded whole-file read; otherwise provide both. When truncated, retry with a narrower range.

get_diff.description: Read verified base-to-current diffs for an exact changed file or recursively below required path (empty for Review root). Results are stable, bounded pages; when has_more, reuse next_cursor with the same path. A truncated file is not marked reviewed.

comment.description: Submit a bounded finding batch. side=old targets removed lines and side=new added lines. existing_code must quote the smallest exact consecutive changed lines, without diff markers or unchanged context. Items resolve independently; retry only rejected_comments indices.

task_done.description: Finish the investigation with a short summary. If rejected with missing_review_files, inspect every listed file and retry. After the retry limit, completion may succeed with incomplete_files.

finalize_plan.description: Submit and finalize one complete selection: General alone or at least two specialists, never mixed. Every reference must be eligible and available. Call exactly once.

verdict.description: Accept or deny cluster_ids. Accept publishes canonical fields. Deny suppresses a contradicted, nonactionable, duplicate, or evidence-incomplete claim whose defect cannot be established; weak/inferred alone is insufficient.

merge.description: Merge only same-root-cause cluster_ids into one Finding. All Comment fields and an exact changed source excerpt are required and become final; each claim, dimension, location, evidence strength, and severity must remain evidence-backed.

finalize_verdicts.description: Finalize after every cluster is covered exactly once by accept, deny, or merge. Unknown, repeated, or uncovered clusters are rejected.
